key: KXAPCALLNJGOV|Will the Associated Press (AP) call the 2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election before 9:00 PM ET?|If the Associated Press (AP) makes its first definitive call of a winner for 2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election before 9:00 PM ET on Nov 4, 2025, then the market resolves to Yes. The call must be an explicit declaration that a candidate, party, or option has won, will win, is projected to win, or equivalent clear language indicating the outlet has determined the winner. The call must appear on one of the outlet's primary platforms (main website, television broadcast, or official social media if that is their primary medium) and not be prefaced with qualifiers suggesting uncertainty such as "appears to," "likely to," "probably," or "may have." The relevant time is when the call first becomes publicly visible on the outlet's platform, not when it may have been written, decided internally, or prepared for publication. If the call is later retracted, the market nonetheless resolves to Yes based on the initial call time. Preliminary exit polls, reporting of other outlets' calls, conditional statements, opinion pieces, and technical glitches do not qualify as definitive calls.
reasoning: The Associated Press called the 2025 New Jersey gubernatorial election for Mikie Sherrill on November 4, 2025, but made this call after 9:00 PM ET (between 9:22 PM and 9:35 PM ET according to various sources). The resolution criteria required the AP to make its first definitive call before 9:00 PM ET. Since all reported times for the AP's call were after 9:00 PM ET, the condition was not met.
